# BCGov Crow - v0.18.1

## Release type

Patch release: clearer guidance for deterministic .NET time and timeout tests.

## Summary

Centralizes guidance for testing .NET deadlines, delays, expiry, and retry
intervals with provider-aware timers and virtual time, rather than real sleeps
or elapsed-time tolerances.

## Highlights

- Explains how `TimeProvider` and `FakeTimeProvider` support deterministic
  deadline and delay tests, and why injecting a provider alone does not make
  ordinary timers virtual.
- Defines reliable timeout-test boundaries: ensure timers are ready, assert
  before and after the deadline, await completion, and test caller cancellation
  separately from expiry.
- Clarifies safeguards and coverage limits, including preserving production
  behavior, protecting the test runner with real-time cancellation, and not
  treating synthetic timeout exceptions as proof that a deadline fired.

## Changes

- Added a canonical deterministic-time section to the .NET unit-testing
  guidance, covering provider-aware APIs, fake-clock setup, deadline assertions,
  cancellation, disposal, and external timing boundaries.
- Linked the C# test-code and language-feature guidance to that section to keep
  the procedures consistent without duplicating them.


Or install the packaged archive:

